product_name: Ceramide & Botanical Precision Edge Recovery Serum

target_problem: Thinning hairline and edge breakage caused by daily drying edge control & tight protective styles

verdict: TOP HERO RECOMMENDATION. Solves the edge tension paradox with precision application and clean non-flaking hold.

target_problem: Intense scalp itching, inflammation, and salt-crystal buildup underneath tight box braids, weaves, and faux locs
mechanism_of_action: Water-soluble aloe + fermented rice water + peppermint + tea tree + soluble ester batana micro-emulsion that instantly cools and hydrates without loosening braid grip
verdict: STRONG DUO PARTNER. High repeat reorder cycle (1 bottle per 6-8 week braid cycle); solves acute physical itch.

verdict: TRIO BUNDLE HERO. Directly solves the white-flake and brittle hair breakage complaint that plagues 70% of edge gels.

form_factor: 60 mL glass dropper bottle with graduated calibration marks

verdict: EXCELLENT EXPANSION PRODUCT. Solves the 'oil just sits on my hair' issue, but slightly more crowded category.

verdict: VALUABLE UPGRADE FOR BATANA PURISTS. Solves the #1 complaint of raw batana (smell), but still exposed to Batana trend decay.

verdict: HIGH-CONVERTING ACCESSORY BUNDLE. Excellent AOV booster and visual demonstration, but lower replenishment velocity on the band.
